content:
Sends a verification code to add a domain to a container.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
Content type
Content type
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string <uuid>
The UUID of the container to add the new domain to.
string
The domain you want to add to the container.
string
The host name associated with the domain name. Typically this is the first
part of the email address of the user you want to send the verification to.
For example, for user@example.com, user  would be the host name.
boolean
Indicates whether or not to resend the verification code.
